verses.text: Ix och ijan ix María yet' winhaj Aarón yalan spekal winhaj Moisés, yujto yik'nak jun ix kusita winh yetb'eyumok.
Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb': Tokwal anhej t'a winhaj Moisés chi' slolon Jehová. Slolonpax t'ayonh, xchi heb'. Palta ix yab' Jehová tas ix yal heb' chi'.
T'a wal yel, anhej winhaj Moisés te emnakil syutej sb'a t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi', elanhchamel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a ix María chi' icha tik: Kotanhek heyoxwanhil t'a sti' hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a, xchi. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' yoxwanhil.
Ixlajwi chi' ix emul Jehová t'a skal jun niwan asun, ix och moyan t'a sti' skajnub' chi', ix awtaj winhaj Aarón yet' ix María chi' yuj. Haxo ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh, ix yalan icha tik:
Ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ayik swak'ankot junok hin chekab' t'a he kal, ha hin tzin ch'ox hin b'a t'ay, tzin lolonpax t'a wayichal t'ay.
Haxo pax yet' winh hin chekab' aj Moisés tik, manh ichokta' swutej, yujto anhej winh k'anab'ajum syutej sb'a t'a skal heb' wik yaji.

K'elk'umb'a tzin aj yet' winh tzin loloni, te jichichi tz'aj hin loloni yet' hin yilan winh. Tato k'elk'umb'a tz'aj hin sat hin lolon yet' winh ¿tas wal yuj tze tek'b'ej he b'a heyalan spekal winh? xchi t'a heb'.
Ix te kot yowal Jehová t'a heb', ix lajwi chi' ix b'ati.
Ayik ix k'e wa'an asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios, haxo ix María chi' sakwekinak yilji sniwanil ix yuj lepra. Ix och k'elan winhaj Aarón chi' t'a ix, ix yilan winh to ayxo och lepra t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Mamin, ak' wal niwank'olal t'ayonh, yujto yuj ko manh pensaril ix och ko mul.
Komonok tz'el t'a ha k'o'ol max kan ix icha junok nene' unin chamnakxo ayik tz'alji, ixtaxnakxob'at sniwanil, xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés chi' yalan t'a Jehová: Mamin, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzik'el jun ilya tik t'a ix wanab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: K'inalok tato ha smam ix stzub'anoch t'a sat, ¿tom max kan ix k'ixwelal uke'ok k'uhal? Okxom yuj jun smul ix ix och tik, yowalil tz'el ix uke'ok k'uhal t'a spatikel campamento. Slajwi chi', schajixioch ix, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' uke' k'uhal ix ik'ji'el ix María chi' t'a spatikel campamento chi'. Ayik ayelta ix t'a spatikel campamento chi', maj b'eyb'atlaj heb' chonhab' chi'.
Haxo yik ix ochxi ix t'a yol campamento chi', ix el heb' chonhab' chi' t'a Hazerot, ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
